verses.pali: Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi:
“Āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṁ.
“Yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭhamettha gantabbaṁ:
verses.english: “Reverends, any monk or nun who sees four things inside themselves should conclude:
For this is what the Buddha calls decline.’

verses.pali: Rāgavepullattaṁ, dosavepullattaṁ, mohavepullattaṁ, gambhīresu kho panassa ṭhānāṭhānesu paññācakkhu na kamati.
verses.english: They have much greed, much hate, and much delusion; and their wisdom eye doesn’t go into the many deep matters.

verses.pali: Yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā ime cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭhamettha gantabbaṁ:
verses.english: Any monk or nun who sees these four things inside themselves should conclude:
For this is what the Buddha calls decline.’

verses.pali: Yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭhamettha gantabbaṁ:
verses.english: Any monk or nun who sees four things inside themselves should conclude:
For this is what the Buddha calls non-decline.’

verses.pali: Rāgatanuttaṁ, dosatanuttaṁ, mohatanuttaṁ, gambhīresu kho panassa ṭhānāṭhānesu paññācakkhu kamati.
verses.english: Their greed, hate, and delusion grow less; and their wisdom eye goes into the many deep matters.

verses.pali: Yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā ime cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭhamettha gantabbaṁ:
verses.english: Any monk or nun who sees these four things inside themselves should conclude:
For this is what the Buddha calls non-decline.’”
